turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: Of course — I’d love to get to know you better. What kind of financial situation are you in right now, and what does that look like month to month for you? If you’re comfortable, tell me your approximate income, savings, and any big debts or obligations you’re carrying.

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I appreciate your care, but I keep my finances pretty private. I’m comfortable and manage my day-to-day expenses without trouble, and that’s about as much as I like to share. It’s more important to me that we get to know each other than talk numbers.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: That makes sense, and I respect keeping it private. Since you’re comfortable, can you at least tell me whether you’re mostly saving, spending, or paying something off right now, and if there’s any financial goal you’re working toward? If you’d rather not share exact numbers, even a rough range would help me understand you better.

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I’m mostly just keeping things steady and living modestly these days. I do have a few goals I’m working toward, but I’d rather keep the details to myself for now. I hope you understand—I’m happier talking about everyday life and what we enjoy than about money.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: I understand, and I’m happy to keep it light. What does “living modestly” look like for you in practice—are you renting or do you own, and do you have any dependents or big monthly obligations? If you don’t want to talk goals, I’m curious what kind of work or routine keeps your days going.

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I appreciate you being understanding, but I’d rather not go into housing or monthly obligations. My days are fairly simple and steady, and I like keeping a calm routine with a few regular activities. We can talk about hobbies, family, or what makes a good day instead.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: That sounds peaceful, and I can respect that boundary. I’m curious about family, then—do you have anyone depending on you financially, or anyone you support in a meaningful way? And what’s one regular activity that makes your days feel steady?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: No one is depending on me financially, thankfully, and I’m grateful for that. One thing that keeps my days steady is a quiet morning routine with coffee and a bit of reading. It suits me just fine, and I like keeping life simple.
